description: This file defines Express.js routes for managing workout plans, including creating, listing, updating, and deleting workouts. It includes Swagger documentation annotations for API documentation, and references controllers, middleware, and validators.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new workout plan, invoked on POST /api/workouts with authentication and validation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists workout plans, supports pagination, invoked on GET /api/workouts with authentication.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing workout plan identified by ID, invoked on PUT /api/workouts/:id with authentication and ID validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a workout plan by ID, invoked on DELETE /api/workouts/:id with authentication and ID validation.
